name: martinjuul/duckdb
description: Native DuckDB driver for PHP (C extension). Synchronous, streaming and asynchronous queries, prepared statements, transactions, bulk appender, typed errors.

suggest.ext-uv: For event-loop integration of async queries via PendingQuery::getFd()
suggest.ext-swoole: >=6.0: PendingQuery::suspend() yields Swoole coroutines natively instead of blocking the scheduler
suggest.amphp/amp: ^3.0: PendingQuery::suspend() suspends fibers on the Revolt event loop instead of blocking
suggest.react/async: ^4.0: PendingQuery::suspend() awaits on the ReactPHP event loop instead of blocking

configure-options.name: with-duckdb
configure-options.description: Path to the DuckDB C library installation (contains include/duckdb.h and lib/libduckdb)
